author: Hermes
question: According to the official GATE 2027 eligibility criteria, can a student currently in the 3rd year of an undergraduate degree appear for GATE 2027?
solution: The official eligibility page states candidates currently studying in the 3rd or higher years of any undergraduate degree programme, or who have completed a government-approved degree, are eligible. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/eligibility_criteria
subject: Eligibility
